yt_title: Why do 2005 LR3s get 12x the complaints of a 2008?

scenes.caption: Why do 2005 LR3s get 12× the complaints?
scenes.voice: Why does a 2005 LR3 have twelve times the complaints of a 2008?

scenes.caption: 2005: 96 complaints. 2008: just 8.
scenes.voice: 2005 was the LR3's first model year. It logged ninety-six NHTSA complaints and five recalls. The 2008 logged eight.

scenes.caption: 2008–09 rate the most reliable
scenes.voice: ReRev rates the 2008 and '09 the most reliable LR3s, and they log the fewest complaints.

scenes.caption: Run the VIN. Check all five recalls.
scenes.voice: Buying a 2005 anyway? Run the VIN, and make sure all five recalls were done.

end.sub: Every year, with the reasons and sources:
end.voice: Every LR3 year, with the reasons, is on boxy trucks dot com.
